text:
emma: Quick sync — proposing a tighter "scout + handshake" playbook for design partners to cut onboarding time and reduce churn.

emma: TL;DR: three-track funnel (seed → pilot → scale), five touchpoints (intro, tech fit, NDA/legal, pilot plan, kickoff), and a 2-week SLA for initial intake responses.

tj: love the structure. can we add a 'severity of ask' tag so engineering prioritizes correctly? e.g., blocker, enhancement, nice-to-have.

sarah: added a draft intake form: https://docs.redwood.com/dp-intake-draft (mock link). fields: vertical, data constraints, expected qps, security notes.

leo: we need legal + infra checks before kickoff. suggest automated gating: if PII=yes -> require legal sig. if vpn/onprem -> infra checklist.

andrew: for success metrics, propose: 1) 3 high-value use cases validated, 2) <200ms median latency on key flows, 3) <10% beta churn over 4 weeks.

emma: good. also want to route partners by product signal — map to 'platform', 'console', or 'runtime' triage queues. routing rules in one-liner: queries with infra/security -> eng-platform, UX -> product/console, perf -> eng-runtime.

tj: engineering capacity question — can Dedicated support 3 concurrent pilots w/ reserved capacity? if not, propose soft-fallback to hosted + telemetry.

emma: noted. add rollout policy: canary -> 10% partner traffic for 1 week -> 50% -> full. fallback rule to previous model or hosted variant.

sarah: draft of screening rubric (quick):
```
1. Strategic fit (3/5)
2. Data readiness (2/5)
3. Security constraints (pass/fail)
4. Estimated QPS & latency sensitivity
5. Integration path (SDK/REST)
```

leo: +1. for security constraints add KMS requirement flag. infra will accept only if KMS present or customer agrees to managed key.

andrew: what's our feedback loop? propose weekly short surveys + biweekly 30m syncs for first 8 weeks. correlate feedback to eval prompts and unit tests.

dp-bot: Reminder: create ticket in dp-onboarding (#dp-ops) with intake form link; template available at /templates/dp-ticket.

emma: action items:
- sarah: finalize intake form + rubric by Fri
- leo: infra gating checklist + KMS policy by EOD Tue
- tj: capacity answer and fallback plan by Wed
- andrew: success metric dashboard prototype (Grafana panel) by next Tue

tj: noted. one more Q — exit criteria? when do we graduate or sunset a partner? suggest graduation = 2/2 validated use cases + 30 days stable metrics.

emma: agree. sunset path = no engagement for 4 weeks OR repeated infra blockers unresolved for >3 sprints.

sarah: i'll also add an onboarding checklist that creates a single Slack channel with named owners (product, eng, se, legal).

leo: ok to pilot this with 4 partners next month. recommend we pick one per vertical.

andrew: if we're good, i'll schedule a quick 30m planning block to finalize the playbook tomorrow 10am PT.

emma: great — schedule it and @sarah @leo @tj join. :thumbsup:
